breve: A physics joint that restricts the rotation of a 3D physics body around an axis relative to another physics body.
descricao: A physics joint that restricts the rotation of a 3D physics body around an axis relative to another physics body. For example, Body A can be a StaticBody3D representing a door hinge that a RigidBody3D rotates around.

metodos.desc: Returns the value of the specified flag.
